ns2:section.sectionText: "This course traces the evolution of Brazilian cinema through selected films, some famous some less well-known. We will focus on different periods of Brazilian cinema (chanchada, Cinema Novo, Cinema Marginal, etc) and their relationship to broader economic, political, and cultural junctures in 20th and 21stcentury Brazil. We will pay particular attention to issues of race, gender, and the urban/rural divide. The course meets TU/TH for extended periods, as weekly screenings will be held during class time. TAUGHT IN ENGLISH.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign or Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
